fix.mechanism: The armed CheckDeadline autoload leaves the tree only at shutdown, after the scene and before native teardown. Its _ExitTree drains pending finalizers and starts a 64 MB no-GC region, so no wrapper is collected-but-unfinalized when CSharpLanguage::finalize runs: Godot's DisposablesTracker disposes every live wrapper, and no late finalizer reaches the CRASH_COND in _instance_binding_free_callback (godot 4.6 modules/mono/csharp_script.cpp).
fix.local_reproduction: From the fix commit: finalizer thread blocked and large-object GCs forced through teardown; unguarded 6/6 runs leaked, guarded 0/6, all passing.
